author: TeIq
content:
**Scope.** Materialize the design.md §4 data model in Postgres + repository layer. Three primary tables + indexes; report data is time-partitioned for the §4 aging-out policy.

**Deliverables.**
- Migration: `subjects`, `incidents`, `actions`, `reports`, `observations` tables with FKs, indexes on `(subject_id)`, `(incident_id, status)`, `(action.moderator_id, created_at)`. `reports` time-partitioned by `created_at` (monthly partitions).
- `polaris-backend/src/repo/`: one module per aggregate (`subject.rs`, `incident.rs`, `action.rs`, `report.rs`, `observation.rs`).
- Each repo exposes typed queries returning `polaris-types` structs.
- Append-only `actions` — no `UPDATE` allowed; reversal writes a new row with `reverses_action_id`.
- Trigger that maintains a `subjects.risk_signals` denormalized JSONB column from related observations.

**References.**
- design.md §4 (data model), §6 (audit append-only with hash chain — chain itself lands in M4).
- `.design/polaris-proto-blue-integration.md` §I.
- `.crosslink/rules/global.md` §Security — parameterized queries only.

**Rust-quality.**
- `sqlx::query_as!` everywhere — no string-built SQL.
- Repos are `pub trait SubjectRepo: Send + Sync` with `PgSubjectRepo` impl, so M2+ tests can swap in fakes.
- `polaris-types::Subject` is the wire type returned from repo methods — no leaky DB-row types in the public surface.
- Time-handling: store everything UTC, render in local TZ at the UI edge. Use `chrono::DateTime<Utc>` consistently.
- Optional fields modeled as `Option<T>` in Rust, `NULL` in Postgres — never sentinel values (`-1`, empty string, etc.).

**Testing.**
- `tests/repo_roundtrip.rs`: insert/read/list each aggregate, assert equality.
- Postgres-backed integration tests under `testcontainers-rs`.
- Property test: arbitrary `Action` values round-trip through serde + Postgres.

**Done when.** All five repos green-test against a real Postgres; migrations apply cleanly forward; no `UPDATE` statements exist anywhere in the action layer.
